applicableDomain: Closed-Loop Critical Finding Escalation & Clinician Result Inbox Governance
descriptionAndPurpose: Closed-loop safety subworkflow guaranteeing that critical laboratory or imaging findings are durably routed to the responsible clinician inbox, monitored against strict acknowledgment SLA deadlines, escalated to a fallback clinician or care team if unacknowledged, and never blocked by financial status.
prerequisiteConditions: Verified critical resultId linked to authoritative patientId, encounterId, and orderId.
Responsible clinician and fallback escalation target resolved.
safetyChecks: Notification delivery NEVER equals clinical acknowledgment; explicit clinician acknowledgment with documented clinical decision is mandatory.
Financial hold or unpaid balance NEVER blocks critical result visibility, escalation, or patient urgent recall.
Amended results reopen clinician acknowledgment even after prior closure.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: CRITICAL_RESULT_COMMUNICATION always resolves to EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE in WorkflowBillingClearancePolicySpi.
exceptionRoutes: AUTOMATIC_FALLBACK_ESCALATION when escalationDeadlineAt elapses without acknowledgment
DEPARTMENT_CHIEF_ESCALATION if fallback clinician also fails to acknowledge
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Critical inbox entries cannot be dismissed without documented acknowledgment; amended results re-enter AMENDED state and reset review requirement.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: Immutable @ClinicalAudit logs for receipt, first view, escalation trigger, fallback reassignment, explicit acknowledgment, and documented clinical action.
completionCriteria: Authorized clinician explicitly records acknowledgment and clinical decision/action (or initiates patient return-to-queue / urgent recall).
